name: NetEaseCloudMusic
text:
#!name=网易云音乐
#!desc=可自定 - 全面净化
#!author=key
#!homepage=https://github.com/Keywos/rule/blob/main/script/wy
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/tv/app/144px/Netease.png
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partW/NetEaseCloudMusic.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
MY = switch,true,tag=[隐藏底部]漫游标签,desc=
DT = switch,false,tag=[隐藏底部]笔记标签,desc=
FX = switch,true,tag=[隐藏底部]发现标签,desc=

PRGG = switch,true,tag=[隐藏首页]问候语,desc=
PRRK = switch,false,tag=[隐藏首页]排行榜,desc=
PRDRD = switch,false,tag=[隐藏首页]每日推荐,desc=
PRSCVPT = switch,false,tag=[隐藏首页]推荐歌单,desc=
PRST = switch,false,tag=[隐藏首页]最近常听,desc=
PRRR = switch,true,tag=[隐藏首页]雷达歌单,desc=
HMPR = switch,false,tag=[隐藏首页]音乐合伙人,desc=
PRMST = switch,true,tag=[隐藏首页]推荐专属歌单,desc=
PRCN = switch,true,tag=[隐藏首页]你的专属歌单,desc=


[Rule]
DOMAIN,iadmusicmat.music.126.net,REJECT
DOMAIN,iadmat.nosdn.127.net,REJECT
DOMAIN,iadmatapk.nosdn.127.net,REJECT
DOMAIN,httpdns.n.netease.com,REJECT
DOMAIN,httpdns.music.163.com,REJECT


[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163.com\/x?e?api\/ad/i then reject_dict(200)
# 今日运势 商城 Beat专区 音乐收藏家 | type:ACTIVITY | 低至5.2折
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/interface\d?\.music\.163\.com\/(x|w)?e?api\/(side-bar\/mini-program\/music-service\/account|delivery\/(batch-deliver|deliver)|moment\/tab\/info\/get|yunbei\/account\/entrance\/get)/i then reject_dict(200)
# 播放页歌名下方∶乐迷团｜关注｜播放页提示｜音乐应用红点｜播放提示?
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/interface\d?\.music\.163\.com\/eapi\/(resource\/comments?\/musiciansaid|community\/friends\/fans-group\/artist\/group\/get|user\/sub\/artist|music\/songshare\/text\/recommend\/get|mine\/applet\/redpoint|resniche\/position\/play\/new\/get)/i then reject_dict(200)
# 搜索页热搜卡片｜猜你喜欢｜我的应用下方提醒
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/interface\d?\.music\.163.com\/w?e?api\/(search\/(chart|default|rcmd\/keyword|specialkeyword)|resource-exposure\/|activity\/bonus\/playpage\/time\/query)/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/interface\d?\.music\.163.com\/eapi\/(mlivestream\/entrance\/playpage|link\/(position\/show\/strategy|scene\/show)|ios\/version|v\d\/content\/exposure\/comment\/banner)/i then reject_dict(200)


[Script]
# mian | 热推、有话想说、分享一下、歌曲下的祝福等小提示去除 ｜ 评论区 乐迷、星评等级 关注 等 图标去除
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/(batch|v\d\/resource\/comment\/floor\/get)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js") with tag="ne_mian", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true

# 伪vip
#http-response ^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/e?api\/(music-vip-membership\/client\/vip\/info|vipnewcenter\/app\/resource\/newaccountpage) script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js, requires-body=true, binary-body-mode=true, timeout=20, tag=ne_vip

# tab
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/link\/home\/framework\/tab/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js", {${MY}, ${DT}, ${FX}}) with tag="ne_tab", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true
# 推荐 | home | 主页
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/(homepage\/block\/page|link\/page\/rcmd\/(resource\/show|block\/resource\/multi\/refresh))/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js", {${PRGG}, ${PRRK}, ${PRDRD}, ${PRSCVPT}, ${PRST}, ${PRRR}, ${HMPR}, ${PRMST}, ${PRCN}}) with tag="ne_home", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true

# 发现
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/link\/page\/discovery\/resource\/show/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js") with tag="ne_fx", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true

# effect
# http-response ^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/song\/play\/more\/list\/v\d script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js, requires-body=true, binary-body-mode=true, timeout=20, tag=ne_effect

# 我的 MyPageBar ad
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/link\/position\/show\/resource/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js") with tag="ne_mybarad", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true

# 显示未关注你
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(ipv4|interface\d?)\.music\.163\.com\/x?e?api\/user\/follow\/users\/mixed\/get/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Keywos/rule/main/script/wy/js/wyres.js") with tag="ne_foll", timeout=20, requires_body=true, binary_body_mode=true


[MITM]
hostname = interface.music.163.com, interface3.music.163.com, ipv4.music.163.com, interface9.music.163.com
